description: This file configures Vitest testing environment specifically for the 'extension-mattermost' project. It imports external configuration helpers, defines functions to load include patterns from environment variables, and creates a scoped Vitest configuration tailored for the 'extension-mattermost' extension, including setup files and test pattern roots.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads a list of include patterns from environment variables or defaults to undefined if not specified.

methods.name: export function createExtensionMattermostVitestConfig( createExtensionMattermostVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for the 'extension-mattermost' extension, merging environment-based include patterns with default test roots.
